design_intent: Add a deterministic, replayable scarcity-pool ordering and a full scarcity-combination ranking, while promoting 50/30/20 from number-level exposure to complete-combination origin quotas.

scarcity_combination_quality.purpose: Prevent one or two extreme scarcity numbers from masking a weak member through the average alone.

review_metrics: exact winning combination rank when candidate-eligible
best matching combination and its rank
first rank reaching each hit count
Top10 / Top50 / Top100 / full-ranking max and mean hits
anti_leakage: All ranking features are computed through the declared history cutoff. Target outcomes may only be applied by the replay review function after freeze.
claim_scope: Scarcity and historical collision are descriptive research features and do not imply increased future winning probability.
